audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side said 'Pantheon' while win[5] said 'Aurelion Sol', and phases[6].side said 'Skill' while win[6] said 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: phases[5].why already describes the Rod of Ages / E-execute stage as his, and Pantheon falls off — the content layer was right and the full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: Both full-layer sides set to 'Aurelion Sol'. Rows 0-4 stay Pantheon, matching a 50.91% overall with an early-game bully.

audit.whatIsWrong: His ultimate was called 'Grand Skyfall' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1]. Breath of Light was 'Q Starfire' and the Aurelion Sol ultimate was 'Voice of Light'.
audit.why: Riot kit: the ability is Grand Starfall, 180/165/150s, 5500 range. Aurelion Sol's Q is Breath of Light; his R is Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
audit.corrected: All five instances corrected and the real cooldown and range used to make the spike concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were entirely absent: Aegis Assault's directional invulnerability, Falling Star cancelling that channel, and Shield Vault being point-and-click.
audit.why: Riot text: Aegis Assault makes him 'invulnerable to damage from the front' and is a channel — so the beam must come from the side, and Falling Star's stun cancels it. Shield Vault is a 600-range targeted dash stun with an auto reset: there is nothing to sidestep, only a cooldown to wait out, and it ends Breath of Light instantly. Mortal Will empowers his next spell off spells OR attacks, so minion hits charge it.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, ahead, late, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet counted zero sequencing cues and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and 600 range against a 750-range beam; Aegis Assault 22s at rank 1; Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Concrete 'hold the beam until his W is spent' and 'save the stun for the shield' lines added with the real numbers.

notes: Aegis Assault's directional invulnerability ('invulnerable to damage from the front') is the single highest-value fact in this matchup and was absent from every field — I put it in spikes[1], spikes[3], ahead and late. The missing-interactions file also claims Astral Flight 'shuts off' Shield Vault and Grand Starfall; nothing in either kit's text supports Astral Flight denying a dash, so I did not write it. Whether Grand Starfall can be interrupted during its composure phase is not in the kit text and was not asserted.
